title: Sequencing: debate speakers
bodyMd:
Five speakers address a debate in five successive positions.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Ada, Bela, Ciro, Dina, Enzo.

- Ada must occupy position 1 or position 5.
- Bela must precede Dina.
- Ciro must precede Enzo.
- Bela and Ciro must not occupy consecutive positions.
